title: Extraction and speciation studies of new diglycolamides for selective recovery of americium by solvent extraction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9864-9874
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00815H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Filip Kolesar, Cécile Marie, Laurence Berthon, Karen Van Hecke, Ken Verguts, Thomas Cardinaels, Koen Binnemans
New diglycolamide extractants with varying alkyl chains were synthesized and their selectivity in americium separation processes was evaluated through extraction experiments. Speciation was used to elucidate the formed complexes.
